messages.subject: [IT] Document management system maintenance – Saturday 14 March
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

The DMS will be unavailable from 20:00 on Saturday 14 March until approximately 02:00 Sunday for scheduled maintenance and indexing. Please check in any documents you are working on before 19:30 and avoid local copies. Email will be unaffected.

Thanks,
IT Helpdesk
Whitfield Carter LLP
